name: Bronze Jin with Cloud Design
description: Bronze ban with cloud pattern, a bronze table used to hold wine glasses in the Spring and Autumn Period. "Forbidden" means abstaining from drinking, and is used to warn people not to cause catastrophe due to excessive drinking. Its appearance is like a jade bed, surrounded by dragons and tigers. Twelve dragon-shaped animals face the center of the forbidden area, sticking out their heads and sticking out their tongues, forming a breathtaking scene of dragons defending it. It is an important cultural relic of the country and appeared on the stage of "National Treasure" in 2017. Pinku joins hands with Wuxitang to recreate classics with metal puzzles, giving new vitality to cultural relics.
